summary: Living Oracle OS backend + frontend tested end-to-end. 23/23 pytest voice-oracle tests pass (see /app/backend/tests/test_voice_oracle.py, JUnit at /app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_voice_oracle.xml). All requested untested paths verified: (1) engine routing — tarot question → engine=tarot, dream → engine=dream, mindfulness-breath → engine=mindfulness; (2) context memory — 'My name is Arjun and I love Priya at work…' followed by 'What if she says no?' stayed contextual (no clarify, 6+ contextual signals matched); (3) one-breath clarification — with a FRESH registered user asking 'When will it happen?' the oracle returned mode=clarify with a short single-question answer (<=30 words, contains '?'); (4) spoken commands — 'calm me now' → action=rescue with breath+safe keywords, 'save this moment' → action=saved (and 'play my guidance' returns the exact saved answer), save without prior reading → graceful action=none, 'where did this answer come from' → mode=refine:source action=answer (after a substantive tarot reading), 'challenge this answer' → mode=refine:challenge, 'forget this conversation' → action=forgotten mode=system, 'delete my voice history' → action=deleted AND owner voice-log rows for that user are gone AND subsequent 'play my guidance' returns action=none; (5) /api/voice/refine with each of deeper/shorter/practical/alternative/challenge/source → 200 with mode=refine:<direction>; refine without any prior reading → graceful 200 action=none, NOT an error; (6) /api/owner/voice-log — 401 unauth, 403 for customer, 200 for owner with keys readings/failed/engines/total/bookmarks, readings carry email+engine+mode and no _id. Regression on /auth/login, /auth/register, /auth/me, /settings, /owner/overview all 200. All answers are spoken prose — no markdown tokens detected (**, ##, ```, bullets, brackets). Response shape has all required fields (id, question, answer, lang, engine, mode, action, created_at) and no MongoDB _id. Frontend (mobile viewport 390×844): customer login works via [data-testid=login-email/login-password/login-submit], routes to /home, orb-btn + captions-btn + theme-btn + logout-btn all rendered, no visible answer text by default (captions off), captions-btn toggles on/off, theme-btn cycles through nebula→aura→crescent, owner-btn correctly hidden for customer, logout returns to /login. Owner login shows the shield-icon owner-btn, opens /owner successfully; Voice Oracle Log block (testID voice-log-block) renders with Sessions=41 / Saved moments=2 / Unclear=3, Engines chips (tarot·13, dream·3, general·1, numerology·1, mindfulness·1), and Recent transcripts each showing 'engine · mode' tag, question, answer preview, email + timestamp. Microphone/STT is not exercisable in headless Chromium and was intentionally skipped per the review request.

issues: React Native Web deprecation warning in console: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — home.tsx uses pointerEvents="none"/"box-none" as a prop on <View> in three places (lines ~515, 578, 588). Cosmetic on web; move into style={{pointerEvents:'none'}} to silence.

React Native Web deprecation warning: '"textShadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "textShadow".' — likely inside src/ui.tsx or a Txt style; should be consolidated to a single 'textShadow' string shorthand.

action_items: (Cosmetic) Silence RN-Web deprecation warnings in /app/frontend/app/(app)/home.tsx by moving pointerEvents="none" / pointerEvents="box-none" from JSX props into style={{ pointerEvents: '…' }}.

(Cosmetic) Find the component using textShadowColor/textShadowOffset/textShadowRadius (probably a Txt heading style in /app/frontend/src/ui.tsx or /app/theme) and switch to the single 'textShadow' shorthand supported by RN Web.
No functional bugs to fix — Living Oracle OS backend + orb frontend are behaving as specified.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1675 lines — well past the 700-line guideline. Split /voice/*, /owner/*, /oracle/*, /media, /tarot, /numerology into a routes/ package (was flagged in iteration_4 too; still open).

server.py contains a duplicated /oracle/consult body: lines 665–762 build 'chosen/chosen_answer' but never use them; the second block (763+) recomputes everything with a different scoring loop. Dead code paths bloat maintenance and hide bugs — recommend deleting the pre-loop.

voice_consult persists voice_turns even for command turns' non-command LLM flow, but command handlers short-circuit and never record the seeker turn. That is intentional but should be documented — 'forget' and 'delete' rely on it.
_save_reading uses substantive=True only for mode in ('answer','council'). Good for refine bookmark behaviour. No change needed.

detect_command uses simple 'phrase in low' matching — a user asking 'Should I save this moment for later?' would falsely trigger action=saved. Consider requiring the phrase to be the entire utterance (or a leading imperative) for safety.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of testable flows (mic/STT skipped as instructed)

seed_data_creation: Each command test registered a fresh disposable customer (email prefix 'test_voice_') so state was isolated. LLM traffic caused some new voice_readings and voice_bookmarks belonging to those test users; the delete_history test cleans its own rows. Existing seeded owner+customer accounts untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full voice suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_voice_oracle.py — run with EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env exported. LLM latency: expect ~90s for the full 23-test parallel run. Frontend testIDs: login-email, login-password, login-submit; on /home use orb-btn, captions-btn, theme-btn, logout-btn, owner-btn (owner only); on /owner use voice-log-block. Microphone/STT genuinely cannot be tested in the web preview — do not fail tests for that.
